name: pdf_go
description: Local, private, in-browser PDF utilities: Merge PDFs & Compress PDFs

scripts.bundle:vendor: node -e 'const es = require("esbuild"); es.buildSync({ entryPoints: ["node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs"], bundle: true, outfile: "vendor/pdf.min.js", format: "iife", globalName: "pdfjsLib", minify: true, target: ["es2020"] }); es.buildSync({ entryPoints: ["node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs"], bundle: true, outfile: "vendor/pdf.worker.min.js", format: "iife", minify: true, target: ["es2020"] }); console.log("Vendor files bundled!");'
